tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Each of the documents uploaded to the KPPP should be selfattested by the agency or an authorized representative in case of firm,company shall be enclosed.
Company Registration Certificate/ In case of a firm, Firm Registration Certificate along ISO 9001:2015 Certification& KPWD Registration

The bidder shall compulsorily furnish composition of the team of personnel which the consultant would propose to provide and the tasks which would be assigned to each team members - Details of Key Professional staff-1.Team Leader -01 No BE Civil with minimum 10Years Experience2.Mechanical Engineer- 01 No BE Mechanical with 5 years Experience3.Site Engineer-03 NosBE Civil with 3 yearsExperience

To qualify for award of this contract, bidder/firm/Company/Consultants in his name should have (in the last five years i.e.,2021-22 to 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of value not less than Rs.6.63 Lakhs. Additional weight age at 10% for each year will be added to the financial turnover to bring it to the 2026-27 price level. Turnover certificate duly certified by chartered Accountant with UDIN number should be uploaded.

The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame and methodology adopted including adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the TOR.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26. The intending bidder/firm/company should have Mandating satisfactorily completed at least90% of the contract value as a prime contractor, at least one similar workThird Party inspection and Project Management Consultancy services for Canal/Aqueduct project of value not less than 50% of the Estimated value of the work for Rs. 3.32 lakhs. Note- Work done certificates should be obtained from the competent authority that is not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent rank officer. Additional weight age at 10% for each year will be given to bring it to 2026-27 price level
The bidder/firm/Company/Consultant should have his OWN/MOU NABL Laboratory for testing of construction materials.

The bidder shall compulsorily furnish the details of owning/hired the following field equipments which are essentially required for the proposed task.1)Sieve analysis set for both fine and coarse aggregate - 01 No2).Aggregate impact value testing machine -01 No3.)Concrete Compression testing machine - 01 No4).Rebound Hammer - 01 No5).Digital Ultrasonic Flaw Detecting Machine - 01 No6.)Triaxial shear test machine - 01 No7).Digital Vernier Calipers - 01 No8.)Total Station -01 No

Line of Credit: -The intending bidder/firm/company shall furnish details of liquid assets availability or credit facilities of value not less than Rs.2.00 Lakhs for meeting the required funds in the form of credits lines/letter of credit/certificate in the prescribed format from nationalized banks/Scheduled banks in the specified format Enclosed as per Finance Department Circular NoFD-CAM/16/2022P-2 Dt: 22.08.2022.
PMC should submit QAP (Quality Assurance Programme) in accordance with the relevant IS standard to the Executive Engineer of quality control for approval immediately after signing the agreement.
other documents should be submitted as per notifiaction and bid document
